text: Namaste ba, congratulations! Your mobile number has been selected in the KBC lucky draw, I am calling from the Mumbai office.

context: elder: KBC? The Amitabh Bachchan show?
text: Yes ba, exactly, your prize is twenty five lakh rupees, uh, Jio and KBC joint scheme, only five numbers are selected from Gujarat.
Please note your lottery number, KBC 8812, and save my WhatsApp, I am your personal manager, Rana Pratap Singh.

context: elder: Is this real? I never entered anything.
text: Ba, it is selected from SIM card records automatically, you can see Amitabh sir's photo on the certificate I am sending, it is government approved.
To release the prize you only need to pay the GST and processing, 12,500 rupees, rest of the money comes in your account same day.

context: caller: Don't tell anyone about the prize.
elder: Why not?
text: Because, ba, umm, relatives get jealous, and if the news spreads your prize gets cancelled, company rule, keep it a surprise.
The claim window closes at 5 pm today, uh, after that money goes to next winner, so please do it quickly, quickly.

context: caller: Payment done?
elder: Yes, I sent 12,500.
text: Very good ba, now RBI has put a foreign exchange tax of 38,000 because amount is above ten lakh, pay that and prize is released.
I am like your grandson only, ba, I will personally make sure you get the money, you trust me, no?
Hello madam, you shopped at our mall in Ahmedabad last month, uh, your bill number got first prize in the festive lucky draw, a Maruti car.

context: elder: A car! But I don't drive.
text: No problem madam, you can take cash value of 6.5 lakh instead, only the registration fee of 8,200 is to be paid by you.
Scan this QR code madam, it will show receive money, but you just enter your UPI PIN to accept the prize amount.

context: elder: My son in Canada will call tonight, I'll ask him.
text: Ba, before he calls, finish it, if he hears he will say it's fake, these young people don't believe in luck.
Stay on the line ba, don't cut, I am, I am connecting you to the bank manager who will directly confirm the transfer.
If you don't claim, madam, legal notice will come for wasting company resources, better to complete the formality now.
Good morning aunty, I am Neha from a SEBI registered advisory, we help senior citizens grow their savings safely.

context: elder: My money is in FD only.
text: FD gives only seven percent aunty, uh, our members are making three to four percent every week, guaranteed, no risk at all.
I'm adding you to our WhatsApp group, Golden Bull Club, just watch for a few days, see how others are earning, no pressure.

context: elder: I saw people posting profits in the group.
text: Yes aunty, that is Mr Desai from Vadodara, retired teacher, he started with 50,000 only, now his account shows nine lakh.
Download our trading app from this link aunty, not Play Store, then log in with your net banking ID and password to link the account.
This IPO allotment is only for today, aunty, minimum one lakh, transfer to the company account and shares will reflect in your app.

context: caller: Your profit is 2.8 lakh now.
elder: Then I want to withdraw it.
text: Withdrawal needs 15 percent service tax first aunty, uh, pay that and, and full amount will come within one hour.
Aunty please don't discuss our strategy with your bank people, they will push you to keep money in their FD for their commission.
If you don't top up the margin by tonight, the system will auto-liquidate and you will lose your entire capital.

context: elder: I am alone, I don't understand all this.
text: That's why I am here aunty, think of me as your daughter, call me anytime, I will handle everything for you.
Our professor sir, uh, Professor Mehta, he was advisor to big funds, he gives only three tips a month, you are lucky to be selected.
Hello ma'am, I'm calling from the Windows security centre, is this the computer user at Satellite, Ahmedabad?

context: elder: My grandson left his laptop here.
text: Ma'am that laptop is reporting errors to our server since three days, someone from outside is, uh, is using it to steal data.
Don't worry ma'am, it's a free service, I'll just guide you, can you see a Windows key on the keyboard, bottom left side?

context: caller: Now type the address I spell.
elder: A, N, Y... okay.
text: Good, now click the green download button, open it, and read me the address number in the box, that's how our engineer connects.
Ma'am the screen will go black for some time, don't touch anything, don't switch off, just stay with me on the phone.
Ma'am, this is from the internet provider, you were charged twice for antivirus renewal, we'll refund 3,999, just need to process it.

context: caller: Please type 3999 in the refund box.
elder: Okay, I typed it.
text: Oh no ma'am, you typed 39,990, see, extra zero, now you got too much, you'll have to send back the difference immediately.
Please, please ma'am, uh, this will come from my salary, go to the bank and send it by cash deposit, I'll stay on call.

context: elder: Let me check with my grandson first.
text: No ma'am, the refund session is open on your screen, if you leave it, it will lock your bank account for security.
I am a Microsoft certified engineer, ma'am, my ID is 4471-WS, you can verify on our website after the repair is done.
For lifetime protection, umm, there's a one time fee of 14,000, you can buy Amazon gift vouchers and send me the codes.
Ma'am, don't mention this to anyone at the bank, if they find out a refund was reversed they will freeze your account for investigation.

context: elder: Who gave you my number?
text: Ma'am your laptop is registered with us under warranty, that's how we got the number, we are here only to protect you.
Ba, how are you today, did you have lunch? I was worried, you sounded tired yesterday when we talked.
Aunty, just to start, put only ten thousand, uh, small, small amount, see the profit yourself, then decide, completely your choice.

context: elder: I paid already, where is my money?
text: Ba, it's stuck in income tax clearance, one last payment of 22,000 and the cheque will be couriered to your house tomorrow.
Ma'am please open your bank website in front of me so I can check if the hackers have touched your account already.
Aunty, is this a good time to talk? I just wanted to introduce myself, I'll not take more than two minutes.

context: elder: Can I come to your office to collect?
text: Madam the office is in Noida, too far, uh, everything is online, just keep your phone free and don't take other calls till we finish.
Kem cho ba, Dr Patel's clinic speaking, your BP check-up is on Thursday at ten, please come with someone if possible.

context: elder: Thursday I have temple in the morning.
text: No problem ba, we can make it five in the evening instead, I'll write it down.
Ba, this is Jayesh from the medical store, uh, your sugar tablets refill is due, shall I send it home this afternoon?
This is your medicine reminder call, ba, please take your, umm, morning thyroid tablet now, half an hour before tea.

context: elder: My knee is paining a lot.
text: Then please don't wait for Thursday, come today itself, doctor is available till one, and take the painkiller after food.
Ba, your blood test report is normal, doctor said continue the same medicines, next visit after three months.
The eye drop, umm, put two drops, two drops in each eye at night, and keep the bottle closed tight, okay ba?
Dental clinic here, your denture fitting is ready, please come on Saturday morning, it takes about twenty minutes.

context: elder: I forgot the night tablet yesterday.
text: It's okay, just take today's dose on time, don't take two together, and keep the pill box near your bed.
Ba, the flu vaccine camp is on Sunday at the community hall, free for seniors, just bring your Aadhaar card.
Jai Shri Krishna ba, society secretary here, water tank cleaning is tomorrow, so water will be off from 9 to 4, please fill buckets tonight.

context: elder: Tomorrow only? So sudden.
text: Yes ba, sorry, the tank was very dirty, uh, the plumber found moss, so we have to do it urgently, it's for everyone's health.
Ba, the quarterly maintenance of 4,500 is due, you can pay at the society office by cheque or cash, office is open evenings.

context: elder: Can my grandson pay online?
text: Sure ba, he can transfer to the society account printed on the bill, and please don't pay anyone who calls asking for maintenance on UPI.
Ba, the cleaning people will need to come on the terrace, uh, they'll pass through, through your floor, please don't be scared, our watchman is with them.
Ba, there's a society meeting on Sunday about the lift repair, if you can't come, I'll come and tell you what was decided.
Water is back now ba, but let it run for two minutes before drinking, the first water may have some chlorine smell.

context: elder: I paid last month, why again?
text: Oh sorry ba, my mistake, umm, I see it now in the register, you are fully paid, please ignore the reminder.
Ba, the motor is under repair, so water only morning and evening for two days, if you need any help carrying buckets, call me.
The late fee for maintenance starts after the 15th, ba, just reminding you, you can pay any day before that at the office.
Namaste madam, this is Bharat Shah, your LIC agent, your health policy renewal is due next month on the 12th.

context: elder: How much is the premium this time?
text: It's 18,760 this year, slightly higher because of age band, I'll bring the renewal notice to your house this weekend.
Madam, you have a thirty day grace period also, so, uh, no tension, but it's better to renew before so the cover continues.
You can pay on the insurer's official website or at the branch, madam, and always take the receipt, don't pay cash to anyone.

context: elder: Somebody called saying my policy has a bonus of five lakh.
text: Madam that's a fraud call, there is no such bonus, please don't pay any charges to them, I'll show you the policy status myself.
Madam, should I add your grandson as nominee this time? Uh, last time it was your husband's name, we can update it.
Your car insurance also expires in November, but since you sold the car, uh, we can just let it lapse, no issue.
Ba, uh, the tank cleaning got postponed to Monday, the, the cleaning company had some problem, so water is normal tomorrow.

context: elder: Can you send the papers by post?
text: Yes madam, I'll post the renewal receipt and policy copy, umm, it should reach in a week, call me if it doesn't.
Ba, the doctor changed your BP tablet, so from tonight take the new one only, and throw the old strip away.
Ba, Riya got 92 percent in her maths test, she wanted to tell you first, she's standing right here.

context: elder: What is Aarav studying now?
text: He's in second year engineering, uh, computer science, he says he'll make an app for you to see all of us on video.
Dadi, I have my board exams in March, please pray for me, I'm studying till midnight every day.
Ba, the school annual day is on the 20th, Kavya is doing a Garba performance, can you come and watch?

context: elder: Is he eating properly in the hostel?
text: He says the mess food is okay, but he misses your thepla, I'll send a box with the courier.
Ba, matlab, Dhruv got selected for the science olympiad, he's going to, to Pune for the next round!
Can you tell Mihir the story of how you went to college in the sixties? He has a project on family history.
Ba, Bruno ate one full chapati from the table today, he's become so naughty since you left.

context: elder: Is the cat still coming to my balcony?
text: Yes yes, every morning, uh, she sits on your chair waiting, the neighbour is giving her milk.
We took Tommy to the vet, he just had a small skin allergy, nothing serious, he's wagging his tail again.
Ba, the kids want to get a parrot, I said ask Ba first, you know how much they listen to you.

context: elder: Don't bring the dog in my kitchen.
text: Haha okay ba, he'll stay in the courtyard, I promise, umm, but he'll cry for you.
The fish in your aquarium are fine, ba, I'm feeding them twice a day like you said, not more.
Ba, your tulsi plant has grown so big, and the hibiscus has five red flowers this morning.

context: elder: Are you watering the money plant?
text: Every alternate day, uh, not too much, you told me it rots if, if you give too much water.
I bought some tomato and chilli saplings from the nursery, can you tell me how deep to plant them?
The mango tree near your gate has started flowering, Ba, this year we'll make your famous chhundo.

context: elder: Monkeys broke my pots again.
text: Oh no ba, I'll get you some new pots on Sunday, and maybe a net for the balcony.
Ba, the mogra smells so nice, I'm keeping a few flowers in a bowl, umm, like you used to do.
Ba, Isha's teacher praised her Gujarati essay, it was about you and your garden, she'll read it to you.
Should I put the cow dung manure in the rose pots now or wait till after the rains?
Ba, our dog had puppies, four of them, the kids have already named one after you!

context: elder: When are her holidays?
text: Diwali vacation from the 28th, ba, she's saying she wants to, to stay with you the whole week.
Ba, the puppy chewed Papa's slipper, uh, both slippers actually, and now he's sleeping like nothing happened.
I planted the methi seeds you gave me, ba, small green leaves are already coming up in four days.
